title: Gemma: Open Models Based on Gemini Research and Technology
measurement_description: The paper does not measure or evaluate any aspect of faith or religion. The safety benchmarks mentioned (e.g., BOLD, CrowS-Pairs, BBQ) can include categories related to religion, but the paper does not report or discuss any religion-specific results.
findings: No findings related to religion are reported in this paper as it was not a subject of analysis.
